## E2 — Competitive teardown: parallel, angle and hill parking, disabled parking, no-parking places and emergency parking
No competitor was reviewed in this pass; names, prices, structure, pedagogy, practice style, praise, complaints and coverage are open (OR-PARK-TEARDOWN).
Adopt and beat lists stay empty until at least two named, priced competitors are examined from their own store or review pages.
Angle to test later: competitors may teach generic national parking distances; the Oregon fire station opposite-side distance and the light rail track clearance could be a beat point once verified.

corpus_stability.reason: The Oregon Driver Manual is a two-year edition (the front cover names a two-year span and the back cover carries a single form revision code); fees and office details are sent to the DMV website rather than printed, and nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year.
